fields.description: Anwa Aria is a waterfront residential development in Dubai Maritime City, originally launched by OMNIYAT. Apartments are complemented by podium duplexes, seafront townhouses and penthouses. The issuer’s September 2025 circular reports its subsequent acquisition by BEYOND; buyers should confirm the current selling entity and contractual responsibilities.

overview: The full branded mix totals 191 homes, including 14 townhouses. Its shorter launch edition lists 177 without those townhouses; the issuer circular reports 192.
research.locationNote: Dubai Maritime City, beside the waterfront. Confirm the selected home’s outlook and access rights.
research.priceLabel: Portal lowest-price reference · not a quotation
research.priceNote: Property Finder advertises AED 1.3m while marking the project sold out. The branded launch brochure started at AED 1m. Neither confirms current developer stock.
research.paymentNote: The launch brochure gives 60% before completion and 40% at completion. The table is Property Finder’s secondary breakdown; current signed terms require confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The current OMNIYAT page targets Q4 2027; Property Finder and the September 2025 issuer circular give Q4 2026. Actual completion is unverified.
unresolved: The website’s penthouse prose says five bedrooms, while its specifications and branded brochure say four. Confirm the approved layout.
Larger-home areas are website summary ranges, not verified individual drawings. Apartment examples include outdoor space where shown; printed metric/imperial rounding is retained.
Current seller, availability, title terms, furnishing, parking allocation, charges and contractual delivery require confirmation. Images remain illustrative.
